opportunities.title: A Federation Wallet Just Proved Why 'Trustless' Sidechains Never Were: Liquid's $320M 'White Hat' Moment
opportunities.why_now: A multisig federation controlling a Bitcoin sidechain just watched 3,998 BTC walk out the door and had to publicly hope the thief is nice — a live case study in centralized-custody risk dressed up as decentralization.
opportunities.angle: Explainer/op-ed: walk through the federation multisig model, why 'purported white hat' is doing a lot of work in that headline, and what this means for anyone holding wrapped BTC on sidechains.

opportunities.title: The Coldcard Hack Isn't Over — It's Laundering: What 'Wave 3' Teaches About Hardware Wallet Supply Chains
opportunities.why_now: The attacker just moved 45% of stolen funds from a third distinct attack wave, meaning the hardware wallet compromise is deeper and more persistent than initial reporting suggested.
opportunities.angle: Security breakdown: timeline of Wave 1-3 attacks, what actually got exploited (firmware? supply chain? seed extraction?), and a checklist for Coldcard/hardware wallet users to self-audit.

opportunities.title: Trezor's Breach Count Just Grew by 67,000 — Here's Why That List Is Now a Phishing Weapon
opportunities.why_now: A second disclosure adds 67K more affected US customers, meaning the total leaked customer database is now a ready-made target list for hardware-wallet-branded phishing campaigns.
opportunities.angle: Threat-model piece: explain how leaked KYC/contact data gets weaponized into fake 'Trezor support' phishing, with concrete red flags for anyone who bought a device in the affected window.

opportunities.title: Two Keys, $91 Billion: The Single Report That Should Terrify Every USDT Holder
opportunities.why_now: A new audit finds Tether's operational security rests on a two-key setup that could hand attackers control of $91B in USDT — a systemic risk hiding under a 'bluechip' rating upgrade headline.
opportunities.angle: Deep dive on custodial key management at stablecoin scale, contrast with self-custody thesis, and what a Tether key compromise would actually do to markets in hour one.

opportunities.title: G7 Just Said the Quiet Part About Quantum — Is Your Bitcoin Migration Plan Actually Real?
opportunities.why_now: G7 officials are now formally flagging quantum risk to crypto infrastructure, forcing an industry that's mostly ignored this threat to finally weigh concrete fixes.
opportunities.angle: Reality-check piece: separate genuine near-term quantum risk from hype, survey what 'fixes' actually exist today (address rotation, PQC signatures), and score how prepared major chains/wallets really are.
